name: pos-crm
description: ทางลัดรันทุก service + เว็บพร้อมกัน (หรือรันทีละตัวตาม README)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix services/identity install && npm --prefix services/gateway install && npm --prefix services/catalog install && npm --prefix services/payment install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n identity,gateway,catalog,payment,web -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix services/identity run dev" "npm --prefix services/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix services/catalog run dev" "npm --prefix services/payment run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/identity test && npm --prefix services/gateway test
